# Quantum Heralded Phase Reference

> A charge-conserving binary phase receiver returns its finite pure reference on every conclusive outcome. Two copies give a sharp finite law. For fixed copy count, reference return incurs an odd-copy scaling penalty.

## Scientific routes

- [Model and reuse](science/model.md): input promise, U(1) covariance, exact branch contract, resource accounting and lifetime.
- [Receiver](science/receiver.md): charge-sector parity vectors, exact fixed-profile linear program, Kraus realization and optimal two-copy reference.
- [Parity law](science/parity-law.md): fixed-copy exponents, sine-power reference construction, odd-copy converse and disposable benchmark.
- [Phase mismatch](science/phase-mismatch.md): zero-error interval obstruction, off-model response, squared-sine design and two-copy return distance.
- [Related work](references/RELATED_WORK.md): imported symmetry and discrimination tools, and comparisons with earlier reference-frame tasks.

## Learn and verify

- [Educational bridge](learning/BARTLETT_RUDOLPH_SPEKKENS_BRIDGE.md): key parts of Bartlett, Rudolph and Spekkens and their use in the project.
- [Milestones](learning/MILESTONES.md): 30 steps from shared-phase preliminaries to the reference-return and mismatch bounds.
- [Verification](verification/README.md): finite instrument, optimization and phase-mismatch checks.
